'''Ryan Hase Death Star Plans''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Ryan Hase]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls19.htm Death Star Plans], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010319190425/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls19.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
